Attribute.value:
title: Authentication Attempt Using a Default-Style Credential Pair
id: b88fd219-6352-4cdb-9406-be4acdc7dfe8
status: experimental
description: >-
    Detects a single authentication event whose username and password both
    match short lists of common default values (admin, root, guest, operator
    and admin, password, 1234, changeme) against router and IoT management
    interfaces. The rule counts nothing, so repeated attempts from one source,
    which is what automated credential brute-forcing looks like, show up as
    many hits and need to be aggregated per source in the SIEM.
references:
    - https://the-hunters-ledger.com/hunting-detections/AdvancedRouterScanner-detections/
author: The Hunters Ledger
date: '2025-10-25'
modified: '2026-10-10'
tags:
    - attack.credential-access
    - attack.t1110.001
    - detection.emerging-threats
logsource:
    category: authentication
detection:
    selection:
        user|contains:
            - "admin"
            - "root"
            - "guest"
            - "operator"
        password|contains:
            - "admin"
            - "password"
            - "1234"
            - "changeme"
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrators using default credentials before hardening a new device
level: medium
Attribute.comment: Authentication Attempt Using a Default-Style Credential Pair | TIER: Hunting | robustness 2 | confidence MODERATE | ATT&CK T1110.001 | rule hash 6fae60c8 | https://the-hunters-ledger.com/hunting-detections/AdvancedRouterScanner-detections/

Attribute.value:
title: Suspicious Router CGI Access
id: e5afdda0-43fc-42b1-b429-05cb0e0bd34e
status: experimental
description: >-
    Detects HTTP requests to CGI endpoints and paths commonly exploited by
    router/IoT scanning and exploitation tools to achieve command execution
    or credential harvesting on embedded web management interfaces.
references:
    - https://the-hunters-ledger.com/hunting-detections/AdvancedRouterScanner-detections/
author: The Hunters Ledger
date: '2025-10-25'
modified: '2026-10-10'
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.t1190
    - detection.emerging-threats
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
    selection_stem:
        cs-uri-stem|contains:
            - "/web_shell_cmd.gch"
            - "/apply.cgi"
            - "/boaform/admin/formLogin"
            - "/cgi-bin/config.cgi"
            - "/login.cgi"
            - "/setup.cgi"
            - "/system.cmd"
    selection_shell_command:
        cs-uri-stem|endswith: "/shell"
        cs-uri-query|contains: "command="
    condition: 1 of selection_*
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative access to router/IoT management interfaces
level: medium
Attribute.comment: Suspicious Router CGI Access | TIER: Hunting | robustness 2 | confidence MODERATE | ATT&CK T1190 | rule hash 236afd6a | https://the-hunters-ledger.com/hunting-detections/AdvancedRouterScanner-detections/
